failure_comparison.claim: Identity comparison only; remaining failures are not all diagnosed.

a3_amine_aldehyde_alkyne.source_program_invariant: Each A3 event joins an explicitly selected amine site, aldehyde and terminal alkyne; multi-event programs preserve event count and order.

source_never_collapse: head on wrong side of the amine-bearing acid
acid_epoxide_diester_multistep.source_program_invariant: Complete amine-bearing acid, complete terminal epoxide and complete hydrophobic acid follow the bound staged ring-opening/esterification program.

source_never_collapse: cross-paper combinations without exact occupancy replay
aema_aza_thiol_addition.source_program_invariant: A polyamine receives its declared AEMA occupancy, then the remaining methacrylate ports receive one repeated complete thiol identity.

source_never_collapse: using a ketone in the aldehyde family
aldehyde_ugi3.source_program_invariant: One complete primary amine, aldehyde and isocyanide form the exact three-component Ugi amide product.

source_never_collapse: changing to or from specialized components in an ordinary lane
calling a one-role replacement local without a role-specific analogue edge
aldehyde_ugi4.source_program_invariant: One complete amine, aldehyde, acid and isocyanide form the aldehyde-derived Ugi bis-amide connectivity.

alpha_isocyanoester_dihydroimidazole.source_program_invariant: Primary amine, complete coupled ketone and alpha-isocyanoester close to the source dihydroimidazole ring.

source_never_collapse: reaction at tertiary N unless quaternary source stratum
amine_alkylation.source_program_invariant: Explicit non-amide amine sites undergo N-alkylation by complete alkyl electrophiles with exact event count and charge state.

amine_epoxide_opening.source_program_invariant: One or more explicitly selected amine sites open complete epoxides with mapped regioisomer and occupancy.

source_never_collapse: changing aryl substitution as a local tail knob
aryl_reductive_amination.source_program_invariant: Source aryl aldehyde/amine systems form mapped reduced C-N linkages while retaining their complete aryl ester cores and coupled arms.

aza_michael_acrylamide.source_program_invariant: Mapped amine sites add to complete acrylamide acceptors, preserving the beta-amino-amide interface and exact occupancy.

aza_michael_acrylate.source_program_invariant: Mapped amine sites add to complete acrylates under a source-subseries-specific occupancy and prepared-tail contract.

source_never_collapse: adding at amide or tertiary nitrogens
disulfide_michael.source_program_invariant: Complete SCC/disulfide acceptors add at explicitly selected non-amide N-H sites; the acceptor linkage and repeated arms remain coupled.

source_never_collapse: calling final products simple epoxide lipidoids
epoxide_opening_o_acylation.source_program_invariant: Mapped amine-epoxide opening creates beta-OH sites, then each declared OH is O-acylated with a complete acyl precursor in source order.

iphos_ring_opening.source_program_invariant: Explicit amine sites open complete alkylated dioxaphospholanes while conserving phosphate connectivity, charge and source occupancy.

ketone_isocyanide_amide.source_program_invariant: Secondary amine, complete coupled ketone and complete isocyanide form the exact acyclic amide topology without dihydroimidazole closure.

source_never_collapse: cross-role rescue of an amine that loses its only basic site
treating interface acetate and long fatty acid as local neighbours
ketone_ugi4.source_program_invariant: One complete amine, one indivisible complete ketone, one acid and one isocyanide form the ketone-Ugi product; the amine must retain a distinct ionizable nitrogen.

maleate_addition.source_program_invariant: One mapped amine or thiol addition consumes the maleate alkene; the two ester arms of each maleate are one complete design object.

source_never_collapse: mixed acids across equivalent OH sites
lipid-like multiarm acids used as one tail
o_esterification.source_program_invariant: Mapped alcohol sites on one complete aminoalcohol are esterified with one complete monocarboxylic-acid identity while the amine topology is retained.

source_never_collapse: old candidates whose only nitrogen becomes an amide
ordinary carboxylic acid without retained basic head
passerini_3cr.source_program_invariant: One amine-bearing carboxylic acid, one aldehyde and one isocyanide form the Passerini alpha-acyloxy amide core; the acid component must retain a distinct ionizable head.

source_never_collapse: changing sulfur placement without a new scaffold
preassembled_thiol_yne_tail_amidation.source_program_invariant: Double thiol addition to one alkynoic-acid scaffold followed by amidation to one complete amine; the sulfur arms remain one coupled design object.

reductive_amination.source_program_invariant: One selected amine site and complete aliphatic aldehyde form the reduced C-N connection with exact oxygen loss accounting.

source_never_collapse: amines that lose their only basic site
thiolactone_aminolysis_michael.source_program_invariant: An amine opens a complete N-acyl thiolactone, exposing a thiol that then adds to one complete acrylate in fixed order.

vitamin_b5_multistep.source_program_invariant: D-pantothenic acid is the fixed stereodefined core; each source series preserves primary/secondary alcohol site order and final head ester/amide identity.
